team_cvs.snippet: outh, with responsibility for Irish medium education at both primary and post-primary as well as the teaching of Irish in English-medium primary and post-primary schools. The organisation has a staff of 22 and are based in Dublin, Kerry, Monaghan, Galway, Meath, Donegal and Mayo. The organization has recently been tasked with enacting various elements of the Action Plan for Irish in English Medium Schools. As part of this action plan COGG will create a website which will house resources and information to support schools, teachers, parents/guardians and students in the teaching and learning of Irish in English-medium schools. A team of five (Project Manager, 2 x Primary Education Officers, 2 x Post-Primary Education Officers) have been seconded from schools for two years to this end. Further information can be obtained from our website www.cogg.ie or from the Department of Education and Youth. | As Irish is the administrative language of the organisation, it is preferable but not essential that Tenderers have the capability to deliver the service through both the Irish as well as the English language.
